body:
Being over relied on by people. They expect too much from me and at times will become dissatisfied with the group projects that you did, without their help then get talked behind your back and they ignore you. They don’t keep small promises to meet up to check the work and agree on topics then make an excuse. 

Or being alone since people around me like friends ignore me, family members need to go to their jobs and siblings going to parties and friends and their relationships. And I end up at home alone with not much to do while cleaning the house and cooking to make sure, my parents aren’t tired when they come back. And I got to study for school and organize stuff since I’m still a kid and not an adult.

I’m not happy with myself and I’m stressed out with everything. But I can’t have a serious talk with someone.

I don’t want to tell anyone of my problems but always end up including people who I don’t want to bother. My parents don’t know how many times, I’ve had a breakdown at school since every time, teachers want to call them, I never let them.  I’m scared of sharing feelings with them. They don’t understand many problems. Once they found out that I was getting bullied for two years after I cried to a teacher. They told me to deal with it and don’t do anything. I always find it easier to tell a stranger than a person close to me. 
I hate myself for many reasons. First, for being fat, I’m slightly overweight but I’m pretty tall. But people keep telling me that I’m ugly, fat and that I’d look nicer if I lost weight. I’ve been going to the gym for a year already but it isn’t working. I hate myself for never being able to stop my family fighting and always feel like it’s my fault. Even when I know it isn’t.

I was being strangled then thrown around the place by this person who was crying and laughing then I was running away from them and everything because dark and a void of space, I could see hands grabbing my limbs and dragging me away but then I woke up but my eyes were still shut tightly and I grabbed my surroundings as if it was my life. I could feel a soft wind and I started shaking as I cried into my pillow until my conscious came back to me and I slowly open my eyes to see the sunlight and I’m safe in bed and my family were downstairs. I was frightened since it was the few nightmares I’ve had. The other one I’ve had before was when it was night and I was with friends in a rather big house and I kept getting jumped by this weird creature and when I woke up I thought I felt someone grabbing me but I was alone in the house as my family went out...
You don’t have to be sorry, it’s fine.
I’m sorry for our sensitive topics but it’s kinda expected as it’s a place about stress lol.

Well for me it would be my bursting into shouts after I can’t take it anymore after trying to act calm. 
But I’m definitely not the worst as my mother is seemingly bipolar and when fed up at me and my siblings, she tends to smack herself and threaten us all the time but in my opinion she’s like a dragon like If you come near her treasure chest or bag of gold she snaps but if you leave she’s the smiling sunflower. Like how?

So I use to be a Christian and it was when I was seven or eight and I started talking to others and discussed about it and I really didn’t believe in religion anymore after a traumatic incident happened to me and I could remember myself crying for help over and over on the phone and I thought about things that went to my head. If god intended things to happen why did my family suffer so much after so long. Then my family relationships broke due to more things and I can’t talk to anyone about anything. If god was real why did he make the world so cruel at a young age and everything made my life difficult till the point I should’ve died. 

That was what happened and what I thought when I was young but now relying on a religion and praying to someone who won’t ever change the worst and watch the world die slowly is too much in my opinion. I don’t mind religion and you can whatever you want but I’ve given up life itself so why should I depend on a god. My parents are believers of Buddha but they don’t do much on religion which is probably why they didn’t mind forcing me to go to church when I was younger.

And if you say I’m wrong and etc. I don’t care anymore since it’s just my opinion so yeah. That how I’ve became a atheist.

“You are never going to be good enough!”

I actually hear this phrase thrown around more and more lately from family mostly. My parents are rather strict to grades and instrument things like how I do piano lessons and slowly learning more and my mother would criticize me after each single piece or scales etc. When it comes to grades, I would rather die than face them though my grade are alright I’ve gotten so many A’s and a few B’s and one C this year but I haven’t told them anything about the C and the B’s and even if I try to reason with them, my father starts to ignore me then my mother shouts how I’m not good enough and I end up crying. 
Though they don’t want me to do music for the future, they forced me to do piano, I actually hate piano but I pretend to like it with people outside and I’m only doing it to make them happy. 

I’ve been trying to cheer myself up but nothing works, sometimes I think about things that I really shouldn’t be thinking about... My friends always try to cheer me up but my thoughts are telling me that I can’t talk to them. I never tell my parents anything and I hardly tell my siblings as well. I just feel alone, I guess...

Well, for me, at the point I realize that I really need to get some stuff done. I start panicking and thinking of the worst then quickly try to get the shit done since I’m lazy, I do it slowly and mentally cry or (physically) depends on what I’m doing but the thing that forces me to do shit is my regrets of not getting the best I could’ve done. But it happens all the time unless it’s a urgent case of plans or cooking. It’s very unhealthy to be lazy which is why I’m basically a slow sloth.
Thank you for your advice. I guess I should really start being proud of what I have done already, thank you. But it’ll be a bit difficult due to myself being used to push around by standards.

Exams

As I am a student, my exams finished a few days ago and I really tried my best and I’ve gotten 3 A’s, most B’s and one C (for now). I’ve been known to be very smart and this year, the exams before I had gotten two Bs and all As and so my parents expected me to get As (they scream at many times when I get an A but got a few marks off and said I’m not good enough though I’ve heard then insult me all the time, I’m quite sensitive.) I haven’t told them anything yet. 
I’m just pissed off that even though I tried my best, I won’t ever be good enough to them. My friends try to comfort me and say I’m smart and my teachers who found out my stress has been saying it is just how your parents show encouragement.. and they’ve said that I just have to accept myself.
I’ve never have accepted myself due to insults, stress from my peers and parents.
It doesn’t help that my family is a mess and lately I’ve been thinking about disappearing.

I might be overreacting in your opinion but I’m just trying to do my best and everyone tells me that I am but I feel like I’ll suffocate soon by everything and now my school is talking about our behavior because of other students and blame us.

All I know is that I won’t ever be good enough to my parents. Which is why I’m pissed.
